reference_prolog:
/*  Self-contained SWI-Prolog program
    State: Colorado
    Focus year: 2021

    Question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?

    Approach:
    - Encode relevant Colorado eviction/possession statutes listed in the prompt as predicates.
    - Encode the scenario facts: an eviction action where tenant seeks to raise "voucher refusal" as a defense.
    - Determine whether "voucher refusal" is a statutory defense recognized by the encoded statutes.
*/

/* ------------------------- */
/* Utilities (self-contained) */
/* ------------------------- */

my_memberchk(X, [X|_]) :- !.
my_memberchk(X, [_|T]) :- my_memberchk(X, T).

/* ------------------------- */
/* Scenario facts (question) */
/* ------------------------- */

state(colorado).
focus_year(2021).

case(eviction_case_1).
eviction_action(eviction_case_1).

plaintiff_landlord(eviction_case_1, landlord_1).
defendant_tenant(eviction_case_1, tenant_1).

/* The tenant has (or applied for) a housing voucher and alleges refusal by the landlord. */
tenant_has_voucher(tenant_1).
landlord_refused_voucher(landlord_1, tenant_1).

/* The tenant attempts to raise this as a defense in the eviction action. */
tenant_raises_defense(eviction_case_1, voucher_refusal).

/* No additional statutory-defense-triggering facts are given in the question. */
tenant_victim_domestic_violence(_Tenant) :- fail.
tenant_documented_domestic_violence(_Tenant, _Documentation) :- fail.
tenant_asserts_habitability_breach(_Case) :- fail.
landlord_received_habitability_notice(_Case) :- fail.
eviction_ground(_Case, _Ground) :- fail.
substantial_violation_committed_by_guest(_Case) :- fail.
tenant_did_not_know_and_could_not_prevent(_Case) :- fail.
tenant_immediately_notified_law_enforcement(_Case) :- fail.

/* Helper predicate summarizing the question scenario in logic form. */
scenario_statement :-
    case(Case),
    eviction_action(Case),
    plaintiff_landlord(Case, Landlord),
    defendant_tenant(Case, Tenant),
    tenant_has_voucher(Tenant),
    landlord_refused_voucher(Landlord, Tenant),
    tenant_raises_defense(Case, voucher_refusal).

/* ----------------------------------------- */
/* Statute translations (relevant excerpts)  */
/* ----------------------------------------- */

/* CO Code  13-40-104 (2021)
   Encodes that certain unlawful detention bases do NOT apply if tenant is DV/abuse victim and documented.
   Text: "It shall not constitute an unlawful detention ... as described in (d.5), (e), or (e.5) ... if
         tenant is victim of domestic violence/domestic abuse ... documented by police report or protection order."
*/
statute_13_40_104_defense_domestic_violence_applies_to_ground(substantial_violation). /* (d.5) references 13-40-107.5 */
statute_13_40_104_defense_domestic_violence_applies_to_ground(other_lease_condition_violation). /* (e) */
statute_13_40_104_defense_domestic_violence_applies_to_ground(repeat_lease_condition_violation). /* (e.5) */

statute_13_40_104_documentation(police_report).
statute_13_40_104_documentation(protection_order).

statute_13_40_104_dv_defense(Case) :-
    defendant_tenant(Case, Tenant),
    eviction_ground(Case, Ground),
    statute_13_40_104_defense_domestic_violence_applies_to_ground(Ground),
    tenant_victim_domestic_violence(Tenant),
    tenant_documented_domestic_violence(Tenant, Doc),
    statute_13_40_104_documentation(Doc),
    !.

/* CO Code  13-40-107.5 (2021)
   Substantial violation eviction: defenses include
   - tenant did not know and could not reasonably have known or prevented guest/invitee's substantial violation
     AND immediately notified law enforcement.
   - DV/abuse victim carveout (no basis for possession) with documentation per 13-40-104(4).
*/
statute_13_40_107_5_guest_defense(Case) :-
    eviction_ground(Case, substantial_violation),
    substantial_violation_committed_by_guest(Case),
    tenant_did_not_know_and_could_not_prevent(Case),
    tenant_immediately_notified_law_enforcement(Case),
    !.

statute_13_40_107_5_dv_no_basis(Case) :-
    /* Incorporated by reference to  13-40-104(4) documentation scheme. */
    eviction_ground(Case, substantial_violation),
    statute_13_40_104_dv_defense(Case),
    !.

/* CO Code  38-12-508 (2021)
   "Except as provided in 38-12-509(2), a tenant may not assert breach of warranty of habitability
    as a defense to a landlord's action for possession based upon a nonmonetary violation ...
    or ... notice to quit or vacate."
   We encode: habitability defense is allowed only in nonpayment-of-rent actions (with conditions),
   and generally not allowed for nonmonetary covenant violations / notice to quit.
*/
statute_38_12_508_habitability_defense_barred_for_ground(nonmonetary_violation).
statute_38_12_508_habitability_defense_barred_for_ground(notice_to_quit_or_vacate).

/* CO Code  38-12-507(1)(c) (2021)
   In an action for possession/collection based on nonpayment of rent, tenant may assert habitability breach
   as an affirmative defense if landlord previously received notice.
*/
statute_38_12_507_habitability_defense_for_nonpayment(Case) :-
    eviction_ground(Case, nonpayment_of_rent),
    tenant_asserts_habitability_breach(Case),
    landlord_received_habitability_notice(Case),
    !.

/* CO Code  13-40-111 (2021)
   Procedural: summons statement says tenant can state why they believe they have a right to remain,
   deny allegations, and whether they got proper notice.
   This does not create a substantive defense like "voucher refusal".
   We encode a generic "tenant may file answer asserting defenses" predicate for completeness.
*/
statute_13_40_111_tenant_may_assert_defenses_in_answer(Case) :-
    eviction_action(Case),
    !.

/* ------------------------------------------------ */
/* Derived: recognized defenses under encoded law   */
/* ------------------------------------------------ */

recognized_statutory_defense(Case, domestic_violence) :-
    (   statute_13_40_104_dv_defense(Case)
    ;   statute_13_40_107_5_dv_no_basis(Case)
    ),
    !.
recognized_statutory_defense(Case, guest_unknown_substantial_violation) :-
    statute_13_40_107_5_guest_defense(Case),
    !.
recognized_statutory_defense(Case, habitability_breach_nonpayment) :-
    statute_38_12_507_habitability_defense_for_nonpayment(Case),
    !.

/* Any defense not mapped above is not recognized by the encoded statutes. */
recognized_statutory_defense(_Case, _Other) :-
    fail.

/* Can tenant raise a particular defense in this eviction action?
   - Must be something the statutes recognize as a defense/basis to deny possession (as encoded here).
*/
can_raise_defense(Case, Defense) :-
    statute_13_40_111_tenant_may_assert_defenses_in_answer(Case),
    recognized_statutory_defense(Case, Defense),
    !.
can_raise_defense(_Case, _Defense) :-
    fail.

/* ------------------------- */
/* Answer the posed question */
/* ------------------------- */

housing_answer(yes) :-
    scenario_statement,
    case(Case),
    /* The defense the tenant wants to raise is "voucher_refusal". */
    can_raise_defense(Case, voucher_refusal),
    !.
housing_answer(no) :-
    scenario_statement,
    !.

main :-
    housing_answer(Result),
    format('housing_answer(~w).~n', [Result]).


:- initialization(main, main).

expected.question: In an eviction action, can a tenant rebut/raise the defense that the landlord refused a voucher?
